threat_model.claim_boundary: A relay cannot make an honest peer accept a forged, substituted, cross-session, cross-purpose, reordered or conflicting peer payload. It can always withhold service or make a protected operation abort. This is not malicious-secure MPC and does not protect against participating peers that deliberately disclose or collude.

channels.binding: Ed25519-signed session, operation, sender peer id, recipient peer id, capability, total length and full payload hash; every frame binds absolute offset, sequence, chunk length and chunk hash
channels.retry_contract: exact frame duplicates return the monotonic committed-byte acknowledgement; gaps, conflicting duplicates, rollback and skips abort
channels.metadata_visibility: session-scoped operation identifiers, peer capabilities, frame sizes and offsets are public transport metadata

channels.binding: producer-signed capability ticket binds session, transfer, replay id, family, producer, consumer, phase, ring, shape, count, server-derived destination, sender, recipient, complete peer-binding digest, sequence and payload hash; Frequency additionally binds its signed analysis, authorization set, fixed window geometry and two server-held authority roles; recipient signs the terminal receipt
channels.retry_contract: producer response and recipient acknowledgement are byte-identical for one exact request; absolute offsets permit lost-response retry without duplicating bytes, and a Frequency window is consumed only after its committed finalization record exists
channels.metadata_visibility: capability, bounded shape and ciphertext length are public; sensitive capability producers emit recipient-sealed bytes

channels.binding: signed padded-PSI contract and relay envelope bind the complete pinset, sender, recipient, session, method, protocol round, operation, fixed public shape and ciphertext hash
channels.retry_contract: absolute cursors and signed terminal receipts make an identical retry idempotent; reordered or conflicting protocol phases abort
channels.metadata_visibility: fixed padded dimensions, protocol phase and ciphertext length are public; patient identifiers and membership bits remain encrypted

channels.binding: server policy selects exactly two peers from the full K-peer pinset; signed ephemeral keys and every exchange bind the full pinset digest, designated roles, session, operation, purpose, ring, precision, public bounds, vector length, absolute offset and payload hash
channels.retry_contract: one protocol attempt has immutable context and absolute acknowledgements; exact replay returns cached bytes while offset rollback, skips, substitutions and cross-context frames abort
channels.metadata_visibility: designated peer names, public numeric certificate, protocol phase and encrypted frame shape are public

channels.payload_class: Ring128 source shares for two designated noise peers
channels.binding: recipient ticket and source signature bind capsule, logical snapshot, workload, source context, full pinset, source, recipient, recipient key, transfer, coordinate order, chunk index, offset, shape and ciphertext hash; protected snapshot and value-commitment header tokens are domain-separated HMAC-SHA256 values under an independent per-source server secret and contract hash, so they are not public digests and are not comparable across sources
channels.retry_contract: both recipient ciphertexts are committed atomically before publication; durable envelope hashes memoize exact retries and canonical source/chunk ordering rejects duplicates with changed content
channels.metadata_visibility: capsule contract and fixed chunk geometry are public; shares, protected snapshot HMAC, value-commitment HMAC and recipient-specific alignment XOR share remain inside recipient AEAD; neither HMAC participates in the patient-alignment gate

channels.payload_class: recipient-specific alignment XOR shares, fixed-shape exact-GC alignment frames, categorical and Gaussian cross-owner exact shares, and signed stage receipts
channels.binding: source AEAD carries one recipient-specific XOR share of every source digest; the exact peer binding and fixed-shape alignment circuit bind capsule, immutable source contract, K, complete coordinate geometry, chunk operation IDs and contexts; a dual categorical-plus-Gaussian capsule reuses that one capsule-bound session and gate, while typed stage tickets, distinct producer/purpose domains and signed receipts continue to bind family, analysis, artifact, private layout commitment, transcript, numeric certificate, stage and peer roles
channels.retry_contract: alignment start/store/seal/receive and cross bind/prepare/finalize memoize identical requests; changed chunks, offsets, contexts, peer blobs, artifacts, stages, peer bindings or receipts abort
channels.terminal_integrity_outcome: after every public-shape chunk completes, only complete or alignment_contract_invalid is released; content, shape, phase and source mismatch locations are semantically indistinguishable, while physical timing and availability remain out of scope
channels.metadata_visibility: K, public chunk geometry, operation contexts, artifact/numeric-certificate hashes, stage and padded dimensions are visible; source digests, per-source predicates, mismatch location, validity shares, masked aggregate shares and exact intermediates are not released

channels.payload_class: designated-peer DP computation and recipient-encrypted final-share transfer
channels.binding: The Count artifact, full semantic contract, analysis binding, circuit, bounds and exact-GC context bind sender, recipient and payload hash.
channels.retry_contract: Count session records replay the same recipient ciphertext for an identical request; conflicting contracts, contexts or roots abort.
channels.metadata_visibility: The public Count artifact identifier and ciphertext shape are visible; unreleased shares remain recipient encrypted.

channels.binding: Peer signatures, full-pinset capsule identity, canonical query, logical snapshot and mechanism are cross-checked by every recipient.
channels.retry_contract: Durable compare-and-set records make identical manifest calls replay-safe and reject conflicting state transitions.
channels.metadata_visibility: The canonical public capsule metadata is intentionally visible; no source share or exact protected statistic is present.

channels.payload_class: signed release receipts, DP output replay and terminal acknowledgements
channels.binding: The signed Frequency release contract binds its compiled artifact, authorization set, window and chunk hashes.
channels.retry_contract: The same canonical Frequency release identity replays one committed DP output; conflicting operations abort.
channels.metadata_visibility: the released DP value, public release identity and signed receipts are intentionally visible DP output or post-processing

channels.payload_class: canonical Synopsis contracts, source ciphertexts, authenticated execution records and replayable public DP artifacts
channels.binding: Signed canonical Synopsis contracts bind the immutable snapshot, complete peer pinset, selected authorities, analysis shape, mechanism and artifact identity; source and final-share tickets bind recipient, purpose and payload hash.
channels.retry_contract: An identical canonical artifact replays its durable public DP result; changed contracts, bindings, chunks, tickets or signatures fail closed.
channels.metadata_visibility: Public contracts, public chunk geometry and signed release evidence are visible; source values, sticky seeds, private shares and pre-clamp values are not.

channels.payload_class: caller-keyed legacy blob slots retained for compatibility
channels.reason: the analyst-selected blob key lacks the typed capability ticket, server-derived destination, complete peer-binding digest and signed terminal receipt required by the active contract
these compatibility setup routes are not part of the disclosure-safe remote surface; active exact-GC and capsule setup derives membership from server policy and pinned identities

channels.payload_class: legacy variable-shape PSI and transport setup
channels.reason: the disclosure-safe surface exposes only the fixed-shape padded PSI state machine and its purpose-bound relay
